name: bookorbit
readme_excerpt: BookOrbit A self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics. Copyright (C) 2025-2026 neon and BookOrbit contributors. What is BookOrbit? BookOrbit organizes your books and lets you enjoy them anywhere: on iPhone, Apple Watch, the web, Kobo, or KOReader. Your reading progress, highlights, and status stay synchronized, so you can start a chapter in one place and continue in another. Around that core sit 14 metadata providers, reading statistics and achievements,…
